name: fretlark
description: Open-source tab editor that opens GP files, with a player and sharing library that runs on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.dev: node scripts/version-assets.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --local --var REGISTRATION_OPEN:true --compatibility-date 2026-05-22 --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787 --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.deploy:update: node scripts/version-assets.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --keep-vars
scripts.test: node verify-artwork.mjs && node verify-library-artwork.cjs && node verify-player-artwork.cjs && node verify-library.cjs && node verify-device-cloud-save.cjs && node verify-library-preview.cjs && node verify.cjs && node verify-editor-model.cjs && node verify-editor-controls.cjs && node verify-editor-refresh.cjs && node verify-editor-roundtrip.cjs && node verify-editor-notation.cjs && node verify-chords.cjs && node verify-theory.cjs && node verify-lyrics.cjs && node verify-ascii-tab.cjs && node verify-command-palette.cjs && node verify-automation.cjs && node verify-tunings.cjs && node verify-drum-pad.cjs && node verify-hand-position.cjs && node verify-playback.cjs && node verify-two-factor.mjs && node verify-lessons.mjs && node verify-worker.mjs && node verify-audio.cjs && node verify-practice-audio.cjs && node verify-track-mix.cjs && node verify-backup.mjs && node verify-hifi-player.cjs && node verify-musicxml.cjs && node verify-setlists.mjs && node verify-video-mux.cjs
